title: UpstreamProject
description: Canonical discovered project or repository document for Source integrations in Rampart ASPM (docs/19 §3, §5)

id.description: Unique identifier of the project in the upstream system

name.description: Display name of the project or repository

key.description: Upstream project key (e.g. SonarQube component key, repository slug)

url.description: Web URL of the project in the upstream tool
